title: Swap Screen with Floating Detail Cards
whatItIs: A pale grey slide with headline 'Seamless money transfer for a better banking Experience.', a hand-held swap screen and enlarged You Pay and You Receive cards linked by thin lines, with small captions.
whatItMeans: Pulling cards out at large scale explains the flow while the neutral palette stays calm.
techniques: Headline with the last words dimmed
Hand fading into the background at the bottom
Monochrome UI with coin colours as accents

vocabulary.definition: An enlarged UI piece linked to its place on the screen.
A thin line linking two related elements.
A hand that fades into the background.
